title: HB0578 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to enhanced handgun carry permits.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-31; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514144429 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/HB0578.pdf (LegiScan doc 2674079))
provenance.note: Draft as filed, 2023-01-31; shared document with SB 1121. Deleted subsections (p), (x)(2), (x)(5) are not shown in the text read; per the summary they are the fee provisions. Section 2 replaces (q)(1) with renewal wording. Effective July 1, 2023.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1351): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1351, is amended by deleting subsection (p) in its entirety.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1351(q)(1)): (1) Prior to the expiration of a permit, a permit holder may apply to the department for the renewal of the permit by submitting, under oath, a renewal application.
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1351(x)(2)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1351, is amended by deleting subdivision (x)(2) in its entirety.
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1351(x)(5)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1351, is amended by deleting subdivision (x)(5) in its entirety.
